L'Entretien, c'est le podcast des Échos: L'Entretien is the Les Échos podcast that does something we don't see often enough: factually trying to help us understand the world. No clowning, no chasing buzz, no storytelling. Every week, an expert dissects a geopolitical news topic — rivalries between powers, strategic resources, international tensions — in about twenty minutes, released at weekends on the La Story feed (already reviewed in our episode 5).
Derrière la simplicité du format, il y a: Behind the simple format there's a key element: the person asking the questions. Christophe Jakubyszyn isn't a host who crammed his notes the night before — he's the editor-in-chief of Les Échos, one of France's leading business newspapers. His questions arrive already structured: they set the context, identify the stakes, steer the thinking. And they're short. What a time to be alive.
Pas de copie des codes du moment (narrat: No copying of today's codes (narrative, two-hour conversations): a classic, well-paced interview, 20-25 minutes — long enough to cover each subject effectively, short enough to fit between coffee and everything else.
Pas d'invité célèbre, polémique ou viral: No celebrity, controversial or viral guest: highly specialised experts (such as Benaouda Abdeddaïm, international columnist at Les Échos). Structured, documented answers that provide context and take a step back.
Rivalité sino-américaine, économie du na: US-China rivalry, the economics of drug trafficking in Colombia, Kazakhstan's strategic resources… In twenty minutes, you come away with an opinion on Kazakhstan. On a Sunday morning. That's quite remarkable.
Chaque épisode donne l'impression d'avoi: Each episode feels like attending a lecture — but a lecture you'd actually want to hear, which is far from true of all lectures. The conversation is always built the same way: the current situation, then the historical context, economic interests, geopolitical strategies. By the end, you understand why the topic really matters.
La limite est assumée : ce podcast reste: The limit is deliberate: this podcast remains very… Les Échos. Journalistic, serious, analytical tone. If you're after humour, storytelling or a personality-driven format, move along. But if you like well-conducted interviews and solid analysis, it's exactly what you're looking for. This podcast doesn't try to charm you — it tries to inform you. And that's its greatest compliment.
